column1: # Game profile of Pokemon Brilliant Diamond 1.3.0 (Unity 2019.4.27f1 IL2CPP, SDK 11.4.3, NVN).
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file.
# Virtual address memory: nninitStartup gives pool - used to StandardAllocator, without setting a heap.
# The SDK node-area cut is in dm/tools/sdk_patches.py. A 2 GB pool leaves room beside StandardAllocator for Unity pools; see README.md.
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# Unity sets Application.targetFrameRate to 30 when entering the field. The build-gated engine limiter raises it; display pacing also ignores the game's interval 2.
